notes: Australian Dairy Farms Group (ASX: AHF) — micro-cap Australian dairy producer (Camperdown Dairy Company brand). Owns/operates dairy farms in southwest Victoria + processing/bottling plant at Camperdown. Fiscal year ends June 30. Sub-AUD 30M revenue. Reports in AUD. Persistent operating losses post-2017 — restructured 2022-24, sold farm assets, refocused on Camperdown plant + branded products. Stapled security structure (AHF + AHFT trust).

periods.notes: FY20 (ended Jun 30 2020): revenue AUD 25.0M. EBITDA AUD -1.5M. Net loss AUD 4.2M. Pre-strategic-review baseline.
FY21 (ended Jun 30 2021): revenue AUD 26.4M. EBITDA AUD -0.7M. Net loss AUD 3.6M.
FY22 (ended Jun 30 2022): revenue AUD 28.2M. EBITDA AUD -1.8M. Persistent losses. Strategic review of farm portfolio.
FY23 (ended Jun 30 2023): revenue AUD 27.5M. EBITDA AUD -2.5M. Net loss AUD 5.8M. Continued losses; farm divestment underway.
FY24 (ended Jun 30 2024): revenue AUD 24.8M. EBITDA AUD -1.2M. Net loss AUD 3.8M. Sold one farm; debt reduced. Focus on Camperdown processing + branded.
FY25 (ended Jun 30 2025): revenue AUD 26.1M. EBITDA AUD -0.5M (near breakeven). Net loss narrowed to AUD 2.4M. Cost reductions; branded volume growth.
